name: Para Light Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Para Light Electronics Co., Ltd. specializes in supplying a diverse range of lighting solutions and opto-electronic components to clients across the globe. Its comprehensive product portfolio includes various types of LEDs, such as visible, ultraviolet (UV), infrared (IR), surface-mount device (SMD), plastic leaded chip carrier (PLCC), display, and traditional lamp LEDs. Furthermore, the company provides optical and UV sensors, circuit board indicators, LED backlighting units, integrated light modules, and tailored illumination systems for both commercial and automotive sectors, along with other advanced lighting technologies. The enterprise was established in 1987 and operates from its headquarters in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
